name: 25-no-ceilings-unknown-reserve
incident: 2026-08-21 - review finding while making the missing-ceilings case audible: hr=-1 fell into the pegged branch and answered night forever
description:
A camera whose ISP dump has no MAX gain lines. The AE reserve is then unknown (hr=-1), and -1 is less than every ir_min_headroom, so the silent-probe verdict treated 'unknown' as 'pegged at the dark end - itself proof of night'. Consequence: on such a camera every low ratio answered night, the brightening trigger was swallowed on every fire, and the ratio path could never reach day. Structural stuck-night, with a log line claiming evidence it did not have.

The fix distinguishes the three honestly: reserve present and low = pegged (night evidence); reserve present and sufficient = the ratio may answer day; reserve UNKNOWN = the ratio cannot be classified at all, so the probe escalates to the audible path and the honest day pipeline judges - the pre-redesign behaviour for these cameras, at the pre-redesign cost. The absence of every clip protection on such a camera is also announced once per session as a WARN instead of being inferable only from hr=-1 in a DEBUG line.

Both fleet T20s do publish ceilings (with different ISP digital maxima, 45 vs 32, on the same SoC - no hard-coded fallback could be right on both), so this models the dump variant nobody has met yet. The room light comes on at t=300: the machine must reach day through escalate -> audible probe -> day-pipeline confirmation, within one heartbeat of nothing.

expect_log: AE reserve is unknown - cannot tell a lit room from a railed meter
forbid_log: the meter is pegged at the dark end
